mechanism: Phenobarbital induces metabolism of amikacin via CYP450 enzymes, potentially reducing aminoglycoside serum concentrations and therapeutic efficacy, while amikacin carries inherent nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risks that may be potentiated by enzyme induction effects on drug clearance.
action: Monitor amikacin serum concentrations closely, consider therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM), increase amikacin dosing if necessary, and assess renal function and auditory function regularly during concurrent use.
